displayName: Ankerstein Grosskaliber Neue Folge, Stufe 0 ("Laaske") — 19-stone starter set
sourceCitation: CVA (Club van Ankervrienden), Steinkatalog, Ausgabe Januar 1999 (ankerstein.ch/downloads/CVA/steinkatalog.pdf), page 8-1, table 'Steininhalt Stufen 0-6 Grosskaliber Neue Folge' — the GKNF 0 ("Laaske") column: real per-stone-number quantities (Stein Nr. 1 x2, Nr. 5 x2, Nr. 15 x4, Nr. 19 x4, Nr. 31 x1, Nr. 69 x1, Nr. 108 x1, Nr. 208 x3, Nr. 288 x1 = 19 stones total), summing to the table's own printed subtotal (8 yellow + 7 red + 4 blue = 19). Each stone number's real shape/dimensions cross-referenced against its own individual technical-drawing page in the same catalog (pages 1-1, 1-2, 1-3, 1-4, 1-9, 1-15, 1-17). Independently cross-checked: 19 stones matches Fred Hartjes' summary (fredhartjes-home.nl/Anker.html) of the smallest Neue Folge starter set size ("small sets of 19 to 105 stones"). Downloaded and read directly from the PDF 2026-08-08.
